response_time_seconds.reason: streaming runs report TTFT and the decode window instead of total response time

decode_tokens_per_second.definition: stream decode over 5 runs, structured count task, thinking off, in-checkpoint MTP k=3 active (accept/step 2.077)

output_tokens_per_second_e2e.reason: per-run end-to-end output rates are tabulated in the receipt JSON instead

aggregate_tokens_per_second.reason: single-stream run; concurrent aggregate rates (c2 67.6, c4 60.3 structured) are in the receipt JSON

cached_tokens.reason: bench prompts are uniquely salted; server-side prefix-cache rates are in the receipt JSON (agent suite hit 93.2%)
